entities.name: Dawnhart Coven
entities.description: A group of human witches and warlocks on Innistrad dedicated to nature and community.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Archangel whose death let the coven emerge.

entities.name: Ghrin-Danu
entities.description: God from whom the coven's witches derive power.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: Werewolf alpha whose howlpack attacked the festival.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: Planeswalker who fought Tovolar and tried to protect Katilda.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Vampire who interrupted the ritual and took the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped organize the defense.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker whose intangibility brought the Key to Katilda.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: Key needed for the ritual at the Celestus.

entities.name: Celestus
entities.description: Ancient structure where the festival and ritual took place.

entities.name: Harvesttide festival
entities.description: The festival organized by the coven, attacked by Tovolar's pack.

events.summary: The coven organizes a Harvesttide festival to undo what is wrong with the moon.
events.quote: the Dawnhart coven decided to organize a Harvesttide festival

events.summary: Tovolar's howlpack attacks the festival; the Gatewatch helps and Teferi slows the sunset.
Arlinn feigns surrender and overpowers Tovolar, who retreats with the pack.
events.quote: Arlinn feigned surrender, but then overpowered the unsuspecting Tovolar

events.summary: Kaya brings the Key to Katilda, letting the ritual begin.
events.quote: letting the witches begin the ritual

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual, takes the Key, and drops Katilda; Arlinn cannot save her and the Eternal Night begins.
events.quote: This left the ritual unfinished, and the Eternal Night a fact.

events.summary: Katilda's spirit restores day and reenters her body; the coven becomes a respected force.
events.quote: the coven became a respected force on the plane

relations.quote: Arlinn and Tovolar fought and both got severe wounds.
The withches received help from a group of planeswalkers
using Katilda as a hostage for the Key
